requirements.statement: Define and verify the security commercial requirement.

proposedVerification.condition: The bootstrap response exposes no secret, account, session, credential, configuration or write authority.
proposedVerification.method: Closed-schema contract tests and route authentication review.
proposedVerification.environment: Go HTTP test router using the production route registration.
proposedVerification.dataVolume: Happy, unsupported-method, replay, closed-version, concurrent-read and recovery scenarios.
proposedVerification.reviewCadence: Before enabling any capability or changing the bootstrap contract.

requirements.statement: Define and verify the privacy commercial requirement.

proposedVerification.condition: The static declaration contains no personal, account, usage, billing or device data.
proposedVerification.method: Exact fixture comparison and output-schema review.
proposedVerification.dataVolume: Every field in the closed v1 response.

requirements.statement: Define and verify the reliability commercial requirement.

proposedVerification.condition: Repeated, concurrent and post-error reads return the same declaration without state mutation.
proposedVerification.method: Replay, concurrent-read and recovery contract tests.
proposedVerification.dataVolume: Repeated and concurrent bootstrap requests plus unsupported methods.

requirements.statement: Define and verify the observability commercial requirement.

proposedVerification.condition: The route uses existing transport observability and emits no user or secret-bearing custom event.

requirements.statement: Define and verify the performance commercial requirement.

proposedVerification.condition: The handler performs no database, network or filesystem operation.

requirements.statement: Define and verify the capacity commercial requirement.

proposedVerification.condition: Concurrent reads remain independent and the response stays bounded by the closed schema.
proposedVerification.method: Concurrent-read contract test and exact fixture comparison.

requirements.statement: Define and verify the accessibility commercial requirement.

proposedVerification.condition: The response remains deterministic JSON with explicit capability names and booleans.
proposedVerification.method: JSON schema validation and documentation review.

requirements.statement: Define and verify the ai_quality commercial requirement.

proposedVerification.condition: The route makes no AI-generated recommendation and false capabilities cannot be interpreted as support.

requirements.statement: Define and verify the ai_cost commercial requirement.

proposedVerification.condition: The bootstrap query invokes no model and creates no billable usage.

requirements.statement: Define and verify the commerce commercial requirement.

proposedVerification.condition: The response includes no price, balance, wallet, payment or billing field.
proposedVerification.reviewCadence: Before enabling pricing or account capabilities.

requirements.statement: Define and verify the migration commercial requirement.

proposedVerification.condition: Clients can distinguish exact v1 compatibility and reject unknown fields or versions.
proposedVerification.environment: Server contract fixtures and desktop JSON schema.
proposedVerification.dataVolume: Recognized v1 and incompatible response variants.

requirements.statement: Define and verify the backup_restore commercial requirement.

proposedVerification.condition: The bootstrap query creates no state requiring backup or restoration.

requirements.statement: Define and verify the operations commercial requirement.

proposedVerification.condition: The route, schema, fixtures and handoff documentation ship together and can be rolled back as one commit.
proposedVerification.method: Release-unit verification and Git diff review.
proposedVerification.environment: Repository branch and CI-compatible Go test environment.
proposedVerification.dataVolume: One contract, one route, fixtures, tests and documentation.
proposedVerification.reviewCadence: For every desktop API release unit.
